text:
Riley (Marketing): Quick thread to lock the segmentation & post-webinar routing playbook for next week's 'Inference Economics' webinar. Need two follow-up flows (engineer-focused vs procurement-focused), RSVP cohorts, and SDR handoff rules.

Dan (Growth): Data pulse: signups skew ~60% eng, 25% infra/platform, 15% exec. Recommend 2 emails + 1 nurture per cohort.

Priya (Product): For engineer stream: include downloadable benchmark dataset + reproducible prompts. For procurement: one-pager focused on unit economics and procurement-friendly ROI bullets.

Marco (SDR): Handoff rules I want: tag = webinar:inference + cohort:{engineer|procurement|other}; MQL if attended >= 25m OR clicked booking link OR answered poll as "ready to evaluate". High interest -> immediate Slack alert to #sdr-live.

Eve (Design): I'll create 2 hero images and a 1-page benchmark summary (A4) optimized for exec download. Also short 30s clip for eng CTA showing batch config.

Riley (Marketing): Drafted two subject lines: Eng: "Repro tips + benchmark you can run in 30 mins"; Proc: "How inference economics fits into your budget cycle". Thoughts?

Dan (Growth): Good. We'll A/B the eng subject with a more curiosity-led variant. Set send windows: live recording + 1h reminder, then eng/proc split at 24h.

Priya (Product): Also produce two CTAs per variant: 1) "Run a 10-min cost-latency eval" (engineer) and 2) "Schedule a 15m procurement briefing" (procurement). Both should include calendar links with utm=webinar-cohort.

Marco (SDR): When a calendar is booked from procurement CTA, route directly to Clare (AE) queue. When engineer books eval, route to me for qualification. Use tag hand-off:owner=Clare or owner=Marco.

Ops-bot: Calendar endpoints verified. Webhook /sales/handoff ready. Test successful.

Eve (Design): For the benchmark summary I'll include a tiny table: testbed (seq len, batch shape, GPU), 3 bullet takeaway stats, and a short caveat line. Priya pls confirm numbers by Tue noon.

Riley (Marketing): Survey at close: 2 Qs only: 1) Primary reason you attended? 2) Interested in follow-up? (book eval / procurement brief / no thanks). Keep it 1-click.

Dan (Growth): Metrics we care about: follow-up CTR, bookings by cohort, MQL conversion rate, demo->POC requests. I'll add to dashboard.

Priya (Product): Agree. I'll finalize benchmark phrasing and provide small code snippet for eng email (how to run the eval).

Marco (SDR): I'll prep handoff playbook doc with sample outreach templates for the first 48h and a 7-day nurture cadence.

Riley (Marketing): Owners: Email variants + survey = Riley; Segmented assets = Eve; Benchmarks = Priya; Lead routing & webhooks = Dan + Ops; SDR playbook = Marco. Deadline: everything ready Wed 5pm. Next sync Wed 9am.

Eve (Design): Uploading assets by Wed 3pm.

Priya (Product): Confirmed, numbers locked by Tue noon.

Ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: deploy webhook test Tue 11:00.
